text:
tara: cutover watchdog flagged a sustained p95 regression in eu-west canary. deploybot suggests auto-revert to v4.0.2. Holding for human decision to coordinate CS/legal.

deploybot: ALERT: p95 > 400ms for 3 consecutive 1m windows. Candidate action: AUTO-REVERT to v4.0.2 in 120s. Cause guess: memory reclaim changes affecting KV cache. To cancel: `deploybot cancel 6299012346`.

mike: errors ok, no 5xx. Latency only on batched /embeddings calls.

ops: Trace span points to new allocator path. We can toggle allocator flag remotely but it's risky across mixed infra. Prefer revert, but need CS note first.

cs_lead: We need 15m to get messaging to enterprise customers. Can we extend the hold?

deploybot: HOLD REQUEST: extend window by 900s. Command: `deploybot hold --extend 900 --by cs_lead`. Without a hold, auto-revert will proceed.

tara: @cs_lead please request the hold if you need the time.

cs_lead: Done: `deploybot hold --extend 900 --by cs_lead`. Auto-revert cancelled. Holding manual rollback window.

legal: Quick reminder: avoid stating preliminary root cause. Wording suggestion: "we observed higher than normal response times for some requests; we reverted to a stable version and are investigating." Add expected follow-up time = 60m.

mike: Ops confirms safe to revert. If we revert, pin release and block auto-rollforward. After revert validate p95 < 250ms with `curl internal/metrics | jq .p95`.

oncall_bot: Oncall duty: sam will coordinate smoke and QA. Sam please ack.

sam: Acknowledged. I'll run smoke and a 5% canary after revert for 10m.

tara: Manual revert now. `@deploybot run-revert --to v4.0.2 --ticket RL-9907 --note "allocator flag regression"`

deploybot: Command accepted from tara. Starting revert job 6299012352. ETA ~2m. Will post updates.

ops: Also kick perf harness post revert: `./tools/perf_check --suite=long-tail --region=eu-west`

deploybot: Revert job 6299012352 COMPLETE. Active version: v4.0.2. Post-revert p95 (eu-west) = 210ms. Release pinned and auto-rollforward disabled.

sam: Confirmed smoke good. Starting 5% canary for 10m.

cs_lead: Customer blurb (legal friendly): "We observed increased response times for a subset of requests during today's rollout. We reverted the deployment to maintain performance and are continuing to investigate. If you saw issues, reference ticket RL-9907. We will provide an update within 60 minutes." Sending to legal for final ok.

legal: Approved. Minor edit: change "are continuing to investigate" -> "will continue investigating".

cs_lead: Updated and sent. Sales notified for affected enterprise customers.

tara: Thanks team. @deploybot set-tag release:blocked:RL-9907 and freeze-release-notes=true. Keep pinned until postmortem and QA signoff.

deploybot: Tags set for release 6299012346. release-notes.freeze=true. Thread will remain open until RL-9907 is updated with root-cause. :lock:
